title: Speak before the reveal: a practical method to protect clinical reasoning from artificial intelligence scribe deskilling, never-skilling, and mis-skilling.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 先口述后揭示：防止AI病历助手削弱临床推理
summary: JAMIA观点提出“先口述后揭示”方法，让医生在生成病历前先表述综合与计划，以防技能退化。
key_points: 区分技能退化、从未形成技能与错误内化三类风险

reason: 视角文章提出可操作方法，但无实证评估，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes are rapidly becoming normalized in clinical practice, yet governance frameworks focus on accuracy, privacy, consent, and medicolegal status. Risks to clinician capabilities have received less attention. Speak before the reveal is a proposed method in which clinicians verbalize critical cognitive steps, such as synthesis and plan, before note generation. Recent work distinguishes deskilling in senior clinicians, never-skilling from premature offload in trainees and mis-skilling, the internalization of AI errors and inappropriate use as sound practice. This Perspective builds on emerging evidence that reasoning before seeing AI output may protect unaided reasoning. Training implementation, evaluation, adherence challenges, validation methodology, and governance strategies for training bodies, health services, and scribe vendors are discussed. Speak before the reveal is a low-cost, testable approach to maintaining clinical reasoning for individuals or organizations. Successful AI scribe adoption requires preserving clinicians' ability to work without AI support.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 环境人工智能（AI）记录助手（ambient AI scribes）正迅速在临床实践中常态化，然而治理框架却聚焦于准确性、隐私、知情同意和医疗法律地位。对临床医生能力构成的风险受到的关注较少。“先口述后揭示”（Speak before the reveal）是一种提出的方法，即临床医生在生成病历记录之前，口述关键的认知步骤，例如综合分析和计划。近期研究区分了资深临床医生的去技能化（deskilling）、受训者因过早卸载认知任务而从未习得技能（never-skilling），以及错误技能化（mis-skilling）——即将AI错误内化并把不当使用视为可靠实践。本观点文章基于新兴证据，即看到AI输出之前进行推理可能保护无辅助推理能力。文中讨论了培训实施、评估、依从性挑战、验证方法学，以及针对培训机构、卫生服务机构和记录助手供应商的治理策略。“先口述后揭示”是一种低成本、可检验的方法，可帮助个人或组织维持临床推理能力。成功采用AI记录助手需要保留临床医生在没有AI支持时工作的能力。

title: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging
zh_title: Neuro-VL：百万级神经影像视觉语言模型
summary: 预印本提出在近百万例常规临床神经影像上训练的视觉语言模型Neuro-VL，可解读整套检查并用自然语言讨论所见。
key_points: 训练数据近百万例常规临床神经影像
内部及国际数据集上优于通用与专科模型
可完成诊断、定位等任务并对话交互
reason: 百万级训练数据加国际外部验证，但为未经同行评审预印本，故不入里程碑档
abstract: Medical imaging is essential for diagnosing disease, guiding treatment and monitoring patients over time. Although artificial intelligence has advanced image interpretation, existing medical models often address restricted tasks, while general-purpose proprietary models lack access to private clinical imaging required to achieve medical expertise. Developing models that can interpret complex examinations and communicate their findings in the context of clinical decisions remains a major challenge. Here, we show that Neuro-VL, a vision-language model trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care, can interpret complete imaging examinations and engage in natural language conversations about their findings. Across internal and international datasets, Neuro-VL outperformed frontier general-purpose and specialized medical models in diagnosing, localizing, and describing abnormalities, as well as generating comprehensive radiology reports. The model also compared serial examinations to assess disease progression and more reliably resisted misleading clinical assumptions than leading frontier models from OpenAI and Google. These results extend health system learning beyond individual predictions to interactive image interpretation and longitudinal disease monitoring. They demonstrate how the collective clinical experience of health systems can be used to develop medical AI with specialized expertise and broad clinical capabilities.
zh_abstract: 医学影像对于诊断疾病、指导治疗和长期监测患者至关重要。尽管人工智能推动了图像解读，但现有医学模型通常处理受限任务，而通用专有模型无法获取达到医学专业水平所需的私有临床影像。开发能够解读复杂检查并在临床决策背景下交流其发现的模型仍是一项重大挑战。在此，我们展示Neuro-VL——一个在来自常规临床照护的近100万项神经影像检查上训练的视觉-语言模型——能够解读完整影像检查，并就其发现进行自然语言对话。在内部和国际数据集上，Neuro-VL在诊断、定位和描述异常以及生成全面放射学报告方面优于前沿通用模型和专业医学模型。该模型还比较系列检查以评估疾病进展，并且比来自OpenAI和Google的领先前沿模型更可靠地抵御误导性临床假设。这些结果将卫生系统的学习从个体预测扩展到交互式图像解读和纵向疾病监测。它们表明，卫生系统的集体临床经验可用于开发具有专业专长和广泛临床能力的医学AI。

title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
zh_title: 混合信号：面向脑电与心电的权重空间编程
summary: 预印本展示前沿语言模型可直接读取并编写EEG/ECG模型权重，甚至从零写出网络权重。
key_points: 语言模型可定位生物信号模型中的植入故障
仅凭架构、任务与少量受试者可生成权重
一组实验中接近梯度下降训练效果
reason: 预印本新方法有基线对比，但临床相关性有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. This opens the door to ``training'' by reasoning rather than through gradient descent. Prior work has demonstrated its functionality and promise for game-playing networks and fixing specific failures in language models, even extending to diffusion models. In this work, we present its applicability to models trained on biosignal data, specifically EEG and ECG data. We show that frontier models are not only able to debug specific faults planted in biosignal-based models without being told what these faults are, but are even capable of writing all the weights of a network from scratch, given only the architecture, the task, and a minimal set of training subjects. In particular, in one set of experiments, a language model was able to match standard gradient-descent training using 6times fewer training subjects, through reasoning alone and without any gradient descent step. Networks written by Claude Opus 5.5 also scored higher than classic hand-crafted EEG pipelines (alpha band power, and common spatial patterns with linear discriminant analysis) when built from the same 5 subjects. We also highlight some of the limitations, which include the inability of language models to improve already well-trained classification models, and their incapacity to reliably recognize, from the weights alone, the task a network was trained on. Overall, our results indicate that weight-space programming can be useful for small networks, such as those deployed on edge devices and wearables, but the concept still requires further investigation before it can be used in practice.
zh_abstract: 权重空间编程使语言模型能够读取训练后神经网络的权重并对其进行编辑。这为通过推理而非梯度下降进行“训练”打开了大门。既往工作已证明其在游戏博弈网络以及修复语言模型特定故障方面的功能与前景，甚至已扩展到扩散模型。在本工作中，我们展示其适用于在生物信号数据（具体为EEG和ECG数据）上训练的模型。我们表明，前沿模型不仅能够在未被告知这些故障是什么的情况下调试植入基于生物信号模型中的特定故障，甚至能够仅给定架构、任务和最少量的训练受试者，就从零开始写出网络的所有权重。特别地，在一组实验中，一个语言模型仅通过推理且没有任何梯度下降步骤，使用少6倍的训练受试者就能匹配标准梯度下降训练。由Claude Opus 5.5写出的网络在基于相同5名受试者构建时，也比经典手工EEG流程（α波段功率，以及共空间模式结合线性判别分析）得分更高。我们还强调了一些局限性，包括语言模型无法改进已经训练良好的分类模型，以及它们无法仅凭权重可靠识别网络所训练的任务。总体而言，我们的结果表明，权重空间编程对小型网络（例如部署在边缘设备和可穿戴设备上的网络）可能有用，但该概念在可用于实践之前仍需进一步研究。

title: AI-Assisted Remote Monitoring for Patients With or at Risk of Malignant Bowel Obstruction
zh_title: AI辅助远程症状监测用于恶性肠梗阻患者的试验
summary: 注册干预性试验，拟评估AI远程症状监测能否减少恶性肠梗阻相关住院。
key_points: 主要终点为90天内因肠梗阻住院比例
同时评估患者报告结局、生活质量与资源利用
拟入组140例，尚未开始招募，无结果
reason: 前瞻性干预试验设计且关注临床结局，但尚未招募、无结果，属值得一看档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Hospital Universitario 12 de Octubre; conditions: Malignant Bowel Obstruction, Intestinal Obstruction; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 140; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The goal of this clinical trial is to learn whether artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted remote symptom monitoring can reduce hospital admissions related to malignant bowel obstruction (MBO) in patients with advanced cancer who have MBO or are at risk of developing MBO. The main questions it aims to answer are: * Does AI-assisted remote symptom monitoring reduce the proportion of patients who experience at least one hospital admission due to MBO within 90 days? * Does AI-assisted remote symptom monitoring improve patient-reported outcomes, quality of life, healthcare resource utilization, and survival outcomes compared with standard care? Researchers will compare AI-assisted remote symptom monitoring plus standard care with standard care alone to determine whether remote monitoring can reduce MBO-related hospital admissions and improve patient outcomes. Participants will receive study-specific assessments and follow-up for at least 90 days. Participants in the monitoring group will receive regular automated symptom-monitoring calls, and optional stool samples may be collected for microbiome research
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Hospital Universitario 12 de Octubre；疾病/状况：恶性肠梗阻、肠梗阻；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：不适用（NA）；入组人数：140；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 本临床试验的目标是了解人工智能（AI）辅助的远程症状监测能否减少晚期癌症患者中与恶性肠梗阻（MBO）相关的住院，这些患者患有MBO或存在发生MBO的风险。其主要旨在回答的问题是：* AI辅助的远程症状监测是否减少90天内因MBO经历至少一次住院的患者比例？* 与标准护理相比，AI辅助的远程症状监测是否改善患者报告结局、生活质量、医疗资源利用和生存结局？研究人员将比较AI辅助远程症状监测加标准护理与单独标准护理，以确定远程监测能否减少MBO相关住院并改善患者结局。参与者将接受研究特定评估和至少90天的随访。监测组参与者将接受定期自动症状监测电话，并可选采集粪便样本用于微生物组研究。

title: [Viewpoint] The clinician–artificial intelligence scientist: a proposed career pathway in medicine
zh_title: 观点：临床医生—AI 科学家这一医学职业路径
summary: 《柳叶刀数字健康》观点文章提出“临床医生—AI 科学家”这一新职业路径，讨论其角色、挑战与培养策略。
key_points: 类比传统临床科学家，提出临床—AI 科学家角色
目标是连接技术开发与有意义的临床落地
属观点文章，未报告实证数据
reason: 观点/述评类无数据，按规则最高6分，取中低档
abstract: Traditionally, the clinician–scientist has played a key role in translating fundamental discoveries into clinical practice across multiple medical disciplines. As medicine enters the era of artificial intelligence (AI), a similar role is needed to bridge the gap between technological development and meaningful clinical implementation—a role we term the clinician–AI scientist. In this Viewpoint, we examine the distinctive role, challenges, and development strategies of this potentially new career pathway for clinicians.
zh_abstract: 传统上，临床科学家（clinician–scientist）在多个医学学科中，将基础发现转化为临床实践方面发挥了关键作用。随着医学进入人工智能（AI）时代，需要一种类似的角色来弥合技术发展与有意义的临床实施之间的差距——我们将这一角色称为临床—AI科学家（clinician–AI scientist）。在这篇观点文章中，我们探讨了这一可能成为临床医生新职业路径的独特角色、挑战和发展策略。

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence in diabetes care has historically relied on task-specific supervised learning, such as bespoke networks for retinopathy grading, kidney disease prediction, and glucose forecasting. The emergence of foundation models (FMs: large models pretrained on broad data, typically with self-supervision, and adapted to many downstream tasks) is displacing this paradigm across diabetes-relevant modalities: ophthalmic models such as RETFound, pretrained on 1.6 million retinal photographs, have been reported to outperform task-specific networks on retinopathy grading and systemic disease prediction, especially when labeled data are scarce; transformer-based time-series models are replacing long short-term memory (LSTM) pipelines for continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) forecasting; clinical large language models (LLMs) such as Med-PaLM and GPT-4 attain expert-level scores on medical question-answering benchmarks; and generative models supply synthetic CGM and electronic health record (EHR) data. This review provides a critical, modality-organized synthesis of this transition. We (i) formalize a three-era taxonomy: rule-based risk scores (era I), task-specific deep learning (era II, 2016-2020), and foundation models (era III, from 2021), and map the diabetes literature onto it; (ii) survey foundation-model architectures, pretraining objectives, and adaptation strategies across retinal imaging, CGM, longitudinal EHR, and multimodal data; (iii) expose an evaluation crisis: benchmark contamination of LLM medical evaluations, a near-universal absence in the literature we reviewed of external and prospective validation for retinal and CGM foundation models, miscalibration under dataset shift, and, to our knowledge and within the reviewed literature (January 2016-December 2025; negative findings are time-sensitive), the absence of any randomized evaluation of a foundation model in a diabetes workflow; and (iv) analyze safety risks: hallucinated insulin-dosing advice, automation bias, inherited algorithmic inequity, and privacy exposure during adaptation. We conclude that the decisive open problem is no longer representation learning but grounded, calibrated, causally informed deployment, requiring contamination-resistant evaluation, prospective trials, and hybrid architectures coupling foundation-model representations with treatment-effect estimation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 糖尿病护理中的人工智能历来依赖任务特定的监督学习，例如用于视网膜病变分级、肾脏疾病预测和血糖预测的定制网络。基础模型（FMs：在广泛数据上预训练、通常采用自监督、并适配于许多下游任务的大型模型）的出现正在糖尿病相关各模态中取代这一范式：例如，在160万张视网膜照片上预训练的RETFound等眼科模型，据报道在视网膜病变分级和系统性疾病预测方面优于任务特定网络，尤其是在标注数据稀缺时；基于Transformer的时间序列模型正在取代用于连续葡萄糖监测（CGM）预测的长短期记忆（LSTM）流程；Med-PaLM和GPT-4等临床大语言模型（LLMs）在医学问答基准上达到专家级分数；生成模型提供合成CGM和电子健康记录（EHR）数据。本综述对这一转变进行了批判性的、按模态组织的综合。我们（i）形式化了一个三时代分类法：基于规则的风险评分（时代I）、任务特定的深度学习（时代II，2016—2020年）和基础模型（时代III，自2021年起），并将糖尿病文献映射到该分类法上；（ii）综述视网膜影像、CGM、纵向EHR和多模态数据中的基础模型架构、预训练目标和适配策略；（iii）揭示一场评估危机：LLM医学评估存在基准污染；在我们综述的文献中，几乎普遍缺乏对视网膜和CGM基础模型的外部验证与前瞻性验证；数据集偏移下存在校准不良；并且据我们所知，在综述文献范围内（2016年1月—2025年12月；阴性发现具有时间敏感性），尚无任何在糖尿病工作流程中对基础模型进行的随机化评估；（iv）分析安全风险：幻觉性胰岛素给药建议、自动化偏差、继承的算法不平等以及适配过程中的隐私暴露。我们得出结论：决定性的未解决问题不再是表示学习，而是有现实依据、经过校准且纳入因果信息的部署，这要求抗污染评估、前瞻性试验，以及将基础模型表征与治疗效果估计耦合的混合架构。

abstract: [Journal de mycologie medicale] Dermatophytosis is one of the most common superficial fungal infections worldwide. However, its diagnosis and management remain challenging because its clinical manifestations often overlap with those of other dermatoses, conventional mycological tests have inherent limitations, the disease is prone to recurrence, and antifungal resistance has received increasing attention. This review summarizes current applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in dermatophytosis, with a focus on the use of machine learning and deep learning in clinical photographs, non-invasive skin imaging, and laboratory diagnostics, while also discussing their roles in treatment support, follow-up assessment, patient education, and adherence management. In addition, with the accumulation of molecular diagnostic, mass spectrometric, and epidemiological data, AI may also provide auxiliary support for extended applications such as resistance risk recognition. Current evidence suggests that AI can improve the efficiency, consistency, and objectivity of dermatophytosis diagnosis and provide quantitative support for treatment response assessment and long-term follow-up. With further improvement in research quality and the accumulation of clinical application experience, AI is expected to become increasingly integrated into dermatophytosis management workflows.
zh_abstract: [Journal de mycologie medicale] 皮肤癣菌病是全球最常见的浅部真菌感染之一。然而，其诊断和管理仍具有挑战性，因为其临床表现常与其他皮肤病重叠，传统真菌学检查存在固有局限性，该病易复发，且抗真菌耐药性日益受到关注。本综述总结人工智能（AI）在皮肤癣菌病中的当前应用，重点介绍机器学习和深度学习在临床照片、无创皮肤成像和实验室诊断中的应用，同时讨论其在治疗支持、随访评估、患者教育和依从性管理中的作用。此外，随着分子诊断、质谱和流行病学数据的积累，AI还可能为耐药风险识别等扩展应用提供辅助支持。当前证据表明，AI可提高皮肤癣菌病诊断的效率、一致性和客观性，并为治疗反应评估和长期随访提供定量支持。随着研究质量的进一步提高和临床应用经验的积累，AI有望日益融入皮肤癣菌病管理流程。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Chimei Medical Center; conditions: Nursing Care Planning; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: COMPLETED] This study evaluates whether assistance from a large language model (LLM), a type of artificial intelligence that generates text, improves the quality of nursing care plans and reduces the time needed to complete them. The study included 120 registered nurses working in internal medicine wards, surgical wards, and intensive care units at a medical center in southern Taiwan. Nurses were randomly assigned to one of two groups: * Independent planning: Nurses prepared, reviewed, and submitted a care plan without LLM assistance. * LLM-assisted planning: Nurses entered prompts to obtain an LLM-generated draft, then reviewed and revised the draft before submitting their final care plan. Each nurse completed only the assigned workflow during a single study session. Participants completed a brief baseline questionnaire and prepared nursing problems, goals, and interventions for a standardized simulated clinical case. Tasks were performed in a secure hospital test environment without real patient data. Expert nurse raters who were not informed of group assignments independently evaluated the final care plans. The nursing care decision quality assessment has a maximum total score of 30 points, comprising decision-content quality (25 points) and decision-language quality (5 points). The system recorded task completion time. Researchers compare the two groups' final care-plan quality scores and task completion times.

abstract: Liver disease remains a major global health concern, highlighting the need for reliable and accessible early detection methods. Although recent advances in machine learning, deep learning and quantum machine learning (QML) have introduced promising diagnostic tools, many approaches suffer from limited interpretability and inflated performance caused by data leakage or overly simplistic evaluation protocols. These constraints reduce their reliability in real-world clinical practice. This paper proposes KQML-Liver, a hybrid framework that integrates QML with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to enhance predictive performance and interpretability. The architecture combines parameterized quantum circuits for expressive feature representation with KAN-based functional mappings that capture nonlinear relationships in an interpretable manner. Evaluated on the Indian Liver Patient Dataset (ILPD) under a rigorous preprocessing protocol preventing data leakage, the proposed model achieves 82% classification accuracy and 100% recall, detecting all positive cases, outperforming existing baselines while providing improved transparency in clinical predictions. These results suggest that hybrid KAN-quantum architectures offer a promising direction for interpretable AI-assisted medical diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 肝病仍然是全球重大健康问题，凸显了对可靠且可及的早期检测方法的需求。尽管机器学习、深度学习和量子机器学习（QML）的最新进展带来了有前景的诊断工具，但许多方法存在可解释性有限以及由数据泄漏或过于简化的评估方案导致的性能虚高问题。这些限制降低了它们在实际临床实践中的可靠性。本文提出KQML-Liver，一种将QML与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）集成以提升预测性能和可解释性的混合框架。该架构将用于表达性特征表示的参数化量子电路与能够以可解释方式捕捉非线性关系的基于KAN的函数映射相结合。在严格防止数据泄漏的预处理方案下，于Indian Liver Patient Dataset（ILPD）上评估，所提出模型达到82%的分类准确率和100%的召回率，检测出所有阳性病例，优于现有基线，同时在临床预测中提供更高透明度。这些结果表明，KAN-量子混合架构为可解释的AI辅助医学诊断提供了一个有前景的方向。
